Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Includes Concert Director with same-PC next-bar rejoin, setlist preflight, timing reports and rehearsal. Shortcut Bars support named game icon search and saved party macro cues.
Changelog: Search Shortcut Bar icons by emote, action, status or item name. Emote commands such as /cheer also match.
